<a id="shape_mirror_table"></a>
### [`shape_mirror_table`](../../../src/shape_lookup_tables.asm#L6) `$7E00-$7EFF`

*data*

Mirror table: entry b is b with its four 2-bit multicolour pixels in reverse order. $365f uses it to draw a fighter with facing 1.

- **Referred to by:** [`shape_copy_mirrored_part`](shape_build_mirror.md#shape_copy_mirrored_part) [`$3684`](../../../src/shape_build_mirror.asm#L326), [`shape_copy_mirrored_part`](shape_build_mirror.md#shape_copy_mirrored_part) [`$368E`](../../../src/shape_build_mirror.asm#L352), [`shape_copy_mirrored_part`](shape_build_mirror.md#shape_copy_mirrored_part) [`$3698`](../../../src/shape_build_mirror.asm#L378)

<a id="shape_part_page_table"></a>
### [`shape_part_page_table`](../../../src/shape_lookup_tables.asm#L24) `$7F00-$7FFF`

*data*

Page of shape part p: $80 + p/4, so parts $01-$ff are at $8040-$bfff. $31a8 and $3660 add shape_page_offset; $3109 gives the low byte.
